ai_summary: **Executive Summary: Andhra Cements Limited Compliance Filing**  Andhra Cements Limited (ACL) has submitted its routine compliance certificate under SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The company's Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RTA) confirmed that all dematerialization requests were processed correctly, including due verification, cancellation of physical certificates, and timely updating of the Register of Members. This indicates robust adherence to regulatory requirements for investor services, reflecting positively on corporate governance with no material impacts or red flags identified.
